generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.
The contractor should carry out the work as per specification and directions of Engineer-in-charge and as per approved drawings.
The Tendered work is invited as Item Rate Tender and bidders are requested to quote as mentioned in KPP Portal.
The intending bidders shall not quote negative rate for man power items (Item no. 1 to 7 of the Schedule B in bid document). Failing to which the bidder shall be considered as non-responsive.
The contractor/authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature before uploading the documents.
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Any Modification / clarification will be published in the e-portal web site. The bidders are advised to visit the e portal regularly.

Bidders should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by Govt. from time to time) cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions worker welfare cess Act 1996.

If multiple (L1) bidders quoted lowest same price to the work and the award of work will be done by considering the bidder with highest turnover from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25.

Successful bidders should execute the agreement within 05 days from the date of approval intimated. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for barring to participate in the tender of KBJNL.
Any addendum thus issued shall be part of the tender documents and will be communicated through KPP Portal only.

Contractor shall bear the service tax as per the reverse charge mechanism as per Government of India Notification No 30/2012 Service Tax Dated 20-6-2012 and any modifications/charges notified by the Government of India from time to time and on date of payment.

The original certificates/ documents shall be produced to this office within 3 days from the Intimation letter received from the office through WhatsApp/email/post. If the bidder failed to produce the original documents. Hence the bid can be treated as non-responsive.
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any Certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid
The intending bidder shall upload self-attested letter pad mentioning latest Communication address, land phone & mobile Phone.
Scope of work and other conditions are as mentioned in the tender documents.
The Bidders should Submit the E-portal Up loaded work done certificate by mentioning the work indent no, if not the bid can be treated as non-responsive.
The Security deposit (EMD & FSD) will be withheld as performance guarantee and will be released after the completion of Work/Defect Liability period.
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours.
If bidder found involved in corrupt or fraudulent practices will be blacklisted.
As per Govt order No: DPAR 06 PSR 2024 dated:20.05.2024 it should be implemented.

The Successful bidder shall furnish within 03 days from issue of letter of intent before entering in to agreement, a Copy of Income Tax returns filed mentioning PAN for the financial year 2025-26 (Assessment year 2026-27) prior to date of entering in to the agreement. Failing which the EMD amount will be forfeited and the tender will be rejected and the bidder shall liable for subsequent penal action including black listing.
The amount put to tender is Excluding of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST.
The increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

The necessary certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated in the uploaded tender document shall be scanned and attached to e-tender document and should be visible for technical bid evaluation. The bidders should furnish the original documents for verification at the time of technical bid evaluation. If any of the bidder does not produce the original documents for verification at the time of evaluation, such bids will be treated as non-responsive bid as per clause 26 (4) of the KTPP rules.

Special Note on Labour & Labour Payment: A) Employees supplied by the Human Resources Agency shall not have an employer-employee relationship with the Nigam. B)The employees engaged for this service shall not be paid less than the wages prescribed under the Minimum Wages Act, and wages updated from time to time by the Labour Department must be strictly paid. C)If bill payments to the agency are delayed due to a lack of grants or administrative reasons, the agency must be willing to wait. The wages of the staff shall not be withheld for this reason. D)Agency/Contractor must strictly comply with Labour Department rules and regulations while providing employees. E)The tenderer must mandatorily submit EPF and ESI documents for the engaged employees along with proof of minimum wages credited to the employees bank accounts online, along with the bill. F) The agency must comply with all currently applicable rules, mandatorily make statutory deductions, and submit details to this office every month. G)Joint Venture quotations will not be accepted. H) The tenderer shall have insurance coverage to his personnel to meet against all risk including Electrical and Mechanical accidents while performing the work and operations at the KBJNL substations. The tenderer or his staff are not eligible for any compensation from KBJNL in this regard.

itemList.description: Providing Graduate Electrical Engineer for over all Supervision, Operation and Maintanance of 33/6.6 KV Sub-Station & Pump House Panels as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing Diploma Mechanical Engineer for over all Supervision, Operation and Maintanance of Pumps-Motors,  Valves & Piping system upto delivery chamber as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing Electrician having ITI/Wireman Licensed for Operation and Maintanance of Pump House and 33/6.6 KV Sub-Stations as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing Pump Operators having ITI/Wireman Licensed for Operation and Maintanance of Pump House and 33/6.6 KV Sub-Stations as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing Helpers/Heavy Mazdoors to assist the pump operators for Operation and Maintanance of Pump House and 33/6.6 KV Sub-Stations as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing Sweeper to maintain cleanlyness in the Pump House premises, 33/6.6 kV Sub-Station and Godown areas as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Providing watchman to watch & ward of the Pump House, 33/6.6 kV Sub-Station and Godown as per directions of Engineer-in-Charge.
Supply of Grease GEM-RR3
Supply of Gear oil HP-90
Supply of Cotton Waste
Supply of Rechargeable 5 W LED Hand Torch
Supply of Insulated cutting pliers : 12 inches size
Supply of Screw driver : 18 inches size
Supply of Allen keys
Supply of Box spanners : 12 nos. per set
Supply of Multimeter - Electromechanical Type
Supply of Insulation Tester Digital type (Megger) : 2.5 kV - 5 kV
Providing & supplying Carpet/Mat of 800+ gsm with stain proof, flexible and super absorbent fibre of good quality as per direction of Engineer in charge.
Testing & Commissioning : Capacitor Bank with Reactors - 33kV

Testing & Commissioning of Battery Charger: Wiring: Identification, ferruling, crimping & connecting
i) AC supply cable upto 2 sources ii) Load cables, connection at charger end upto 10 load points- 33kV

Testing & Commissioning of Battery Charger: Testing: i) AC supply voltage phase sequence ii) Testing of output DC voltages in Boost/Float/Trickle/Variations as per the order/ requirement iii) Testing for repel factor Commissioning: i) Fixing of Boost Voltage level ii) Fixing of Float Voltage level iii) Fixing of Trickle Voltage level iv) Testing of alarm, indication and load ckts, auto/manual change overs etc., v) Full load test in Boost & Trickle modes - 110 V DC
Supply of Dehydrating Silicagel Breather Assembly
Supply of Silica Gel

Supplying and drawing Flexible Multicore Cable manufactured with electrolytic grade flexible copper with low conductor confirming to IS8130-1984 and (Virgin) PVC insulation sheathed suitable for working voltage upto 1100 Volts as per IS-694:1990 - 4C x 4 mm2
Testing & Commissioning of Current Transformer - Wiring:Inspection of wiring, ferruling, crimping of lugs, connections in CT, marshalling box & control panel, extension of earth mat etc., - 33kV
Testing & Commissioning of Current Transformer - Insulation resistance, polarity, ratio, excitation, Core identification, tan-delta & capacitance test.  - 33kV

Testing & Commissioning of Potential Transformers (Induction Type Voltage Transformer/ Capacitance Type Voltage Transformer) - Wiring: Inspection of wiring, ferruling, crimping of lugs, connections in PT, marshalling box & control panel, extension of earth mat etc.,  - 33kV

Testing & Commissioning of Potential Transformers (Induction Type Voltage Transformer/ Capacitance Type Voltage Transformer) - Insulation resistance, polarity, ratio, excitation, Core identification, tan- elta & capacitance test - 33kV

SF-6 Breakers: Testing & Commissioning: Test for insulation level/IR value, gas leakage, testing for travel time (C, O & CO & OC), trip and close timings. Local trip close test, remote trip and close test, tripping through relays, operation of interlocks, contact resistance test etc., - 33kV

Reconditioning of accessories like Radiators, Conservator by hot air circulation along with pressure test of radiators and reconditioning of Transformer mounted mechanical relays - 110 kV and below class Transformer
Supply of Transformer Oil as per IS-335:1993 - EHV Grade Transformer Oil - New
Filtration of oil using filter set of the contractor to bring the insulation value to I.E. specification - 33kV
Testing & Commissioning of Power Transformers: Inspection of wires and ferrules. Inspection of wiring of protective devices, cooling fans, oil flow pumps, OLTC, RTCC, bushing etc., - for 5 mva

Testing & Commissioning of Power Transformers:Testing : 1. Ratio Test 2. SC Test 3. Excitation Current Test/ Highpot Test 4. Magnetic Balance Test 5. Vector Group Test 6. Induced High Voltage Test 7. OLTC Operation - Local and Remote 8. Protective Devices Operation Checks 9. Stability Checks : For Differential & REFR Protection 10. Winding Resistance Test 11. Insulation Resistance Test 12. Tan-Delta and Capacitance Test 13. Transformer mounted protective Devices - for 5 mva
Sychronising Trolley/Panel: Wiring, Testing, Calibration of meters & Testing for operation
Servicing of LTAC Panel, ACDB & DCDB

11kV switchgear - Testing & Commissioning: Wiring: Identification of wires, ferruling, crimping & termination of wires for annunciation, etc., Testing of relays, CTs, PTs & Breaker for operation - For single 11 kV panel indoor type. (Servicing of 6.6kV switchgear panels)

11kV switchgear - Testing & Commissioning: Wiring: Identification of wires, ferruling, crimping & termination of wires for annunciation, etc., Testing of relays, CTs, PTs & Breaker for operation - For additional panels indoor type (Servicing of 6.6kV switchgear panels)

Jelly Spreading (20-25 mm) : Supplying and providing jelly in the station yard of uniform thickness of 100 mm including the cost of materials, labour charges, required tools and plants etc., complete. Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of Engineerin- charge of works as per the standard procedure.

Supply & Installation CC tv including the monitor, 3 camera, cablelling, electrical switches and providing internet service (2GB/day for 1 year) with all other necessary arrangements as directed by the Engineer-in-charge

Replacement of old rubber expansion joint (Dia-2000mm PN-16) with available spare with new nuts & bolts including  testing  and commissioning with all lead & lift as directed by the Engineer-in-charge.

Cleaning gates / hoists / embedded parts for re-painting by removing rust, old paint, grease by using wire brush, scrubber, rust remover including cost of all materials, labour, machinery, scaffolding, applying a coat of rust inhibitive compound with all other ancillary operations complete.

Applying priming coat: With ready mixed red oxide zinc chromate primer of approved brand and manufacture on steel galvanised iron/ steel works including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade: One coats on old work as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.
